holding_recommendations.reason: Hostile hidden-temporal,missing-rule,and noncomparability cases preserve the use-specific V553 boundary. Qualification: V553 cannot create source-universe equivalence; required source relation/applicability/comparability authority must be positive or the result fails closed/preserves plurality.
Removing V553 from a temporally complete,V554-rule-eligible use loses no V553 semantics and prevents starvation/no-op transit. Direct eligibility remains explicit and fail-closed.

The no-double-entry principle survives conceptually, but the exact machine-readable semantic-equivalence key and precedence serialization are explicitly deferred. Alias/reissued admission lineages cannot be assumed deterministically deduplicated.

must_carry_into_synthesis: V553 routing is triggered by new consumer-required temporal/comparability semantics, not timestamps, historical-source membership, or artifact presence.
Positive cross-source temporal comparison/harmonization requires positively governed source-universe relation/applicability/comparability authority; same year or labels are insufficient.
A temporally complete,V554-rule-eligible admission must have a direct V554 path or the machine starves a lawful use / creates no-op transit.
Unknown temporal completeness, missing V553 temporal authority, missing V554 direct eligibility, or unresolved source relation must produce no guessed positive route.
For one exact V554 proposition/use/rule, physical availability of direct and temporal paths never authorizes union/latest-win/score-win/order selection.
Until canonical duplicate equivalence is frozen, EQ=UNKNOWN must fail closed.
